channel.title: AI GridWatch — Idaho data center updates
channel.description: Data center moratoriums, proposals, and community-impact headlines for Idaho, from AI GridWatch.

item.title: Kootenai County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: ORA 25-0007: prohibits data centers in the Commercial zone; allows in Light Industrial and Industrial only with conditional use permit; bans data centers over the aquifer. Replaced a 183-day emergency moratorium (Mar 2, 2025). Commissioners directed staff to draft an outright ban in unincorporated areas

item.title: Bannock County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 180-day emergency moratorium on accepting or processing new data center permit applications in unincorporated county; does not affect Pocatello city limits; county to draft standalone data center ordinance addressing water, energy and land-use impacts

item.title: Sandpoint: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: City Council voted unanimously to direct staff to propose a data center definition for a future ordinance banning them within city limits; currently a permitted use in the Industrial Park District

item.title: AI is about to collide with Idaho’s water crisis, and we’re not ready for the consequences
